quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted at traffic signals where you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to workers on or near the road. Be extra careful in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest safe speed you are allowed to drive on that road.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection go first before you enter.

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right ahead.

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. Yield the right-of-way to all vehicles and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane ends and you must move left.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane ends ahead. All traffic in the right lane must merge left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows in one direction only.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction to drive on a one-way street. You must follow the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: This sign means:

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic flows in one direction only.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: This sign tells you:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Yield for a left turn at a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield for a left turn at a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic go first. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic is merging toward you from the left.
The right lane ends, move left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends, move left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane ends ahead. You must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
Reduce your speed only if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a fire station is nearby and emergency vehicles may be on the road.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross first. Be alert when driving through intersections or turning to watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules you must obey. This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely make these turns.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules you must obey. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules you must obey. This sign is often posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Reduce your speed and be careful.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will not work properly because one side of your car is higher than the other.

questions.explanation: This sign shows the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.
